references.label: TMC 3.70.030 block 0
references.quote: (a) The district will be financed by imposition of an annual service fee for 2026 on businesses within the following tier levels:

references.label: TMC 3.70.030 block 1
references.quote: Tier 1: Businesses located in the area bounded by Gordon Street on the north; Norris Street on the south; Quincy Street on the east and Jackson Street on the west.

references.label: TMC 3.70.030 block 2
references.quote:
Number of Square Feet | Retail and Service (Main Floor) Rate | Retail and Service (Distinct From Main Floor Business) Rate | Trade/Office Space/Warehouse Rate
1 – 500 | $100 | $75 | $75
501 – 1,000 | $175 | $125 | $125
1,001 – 2,500 | $250 | $200 | $200
2,501 – 5,000 | $325 | $275 | $275
5,001 – 10,000 | $400 | $350 | $350
10,001 – 20,000 | $475 | $425 | $425
20,001 plus | $550 | $500 | $500

references.label: TMC 3.70.030 block 5
references.quote: Retail and Service (Distinct From Main Floor Business) Rate

references.label: TMC 3.70.030 block 35
references.quote: Tier 2: Businesses located in the area bounded by Morse Street on the north; Gordon Street on the south; Quincy Street on the east and Jackson Street on the west.

references.label: TMC 3.70.030 block 36
references.quote:
Number of Square Feet | Retail and Service (Main Floor) Rate | Retail and Service (Distinct From Main Floor Business) Rate | Trade/Office Space/Warehouse Rate
1 – 500 | $50 | $35 | $35
501 – 1,000 | $100 | $50 | $50
1,001 – 2,500 | $125 | $75 | $75
2,501 – 5,000 | $200 | $150 | $150
5,001 – 10,000 | $225 | $175 | $175
10,001 – 20,000 | $250 | $200 | $200
20,001 plus | $300 | $250 | $250

references.label: TMC 3.70.030 block 39
references.quote: Retail and Service (Distinct From Main Floor Business) Rate

references.label: TMC 3.70.030 block 69
references.quote: However, businesses that had a physical presence in the district on or before January 1, 2008, are not obligated to pay the fee.

references.label: TMC 3.70.030 block 70
references.quote: (b) Service fees shall be due and payable on March 1st of each year. (Ord. 20620 § 1, 12-9-25.)
